what: the six pass rules of one_trait_censored, re-run after the two-person normal integral was replaced and the model generalised to several components
why: Issue 42 replaced the integral every censored heritability rests on, and issues 30 and 32 generalised the model around it. The released analysis had not been re-measured since. Agreement with an external engine is the part that matters: censReg and MCMCglmm know nothing about what changed.

tobit_against_censreg.note: the R side is stored and the Asterism side refitted; censReg's answer does not change, ours could

tobit_calibration.note: the truth is recovered at every censoring rate tried

verdict: All six re-run and unmoved. The movement recorded against the SOLAR successor when the integral changed -- at most 1.2e-6, or 2.7e-9 of the value -- is below what any of these rules can resolve, and none of them moved off its verdict.
